preconditions.description: The integer n is the number of nodes in the tree, and it is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
The integers ai and bi represent the vertices connected by an edge, and they are between 1 and 2n, inclusive.
The vertices ai and bi are distinct.

preconditions.expression: The graph given in the input is a tree
preconditions.description: The graph is connected and acyclic.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to place the tree on the table modulo 1000000007.
